text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Amstrad GX4000 was released in 1990 as a cartridge-based console version of the Amstrad CPC Plus computer line. It used enhanced CPC hardware with improved graphics capabilities compared with the original CPC computers. The system library included arcade conversions and original games such as Burnin' Rubber, Robocop 2, Pang, and Switchblade. Limited marketing, competition from existing consoles, and a small software library contributed to its short lifespan.
